newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no surplus power for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no surplus power for Wednesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no surplus power for Wednesday schedulings, the federal agency said Tuesday.
BPA has not been in the market with spot power since late last week, when it was offering up to 200 megawatts (MW).

Before it withdrew from offering surplus power for Saturday through Monday, BPA offered firm power during heavy-load hours at $25.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $26.50 for COB/NOB deliveries.
Firm light-load power was offered at $19.50 for Friday.
